title: The terminal-section presheaf is a pro-etale sheaf
statement:
Let X be a scheme, F an etale sheaf of sets on X, and P a presheaf of sets on X_proet. Suppose for every weakly etale Y over X an equivalence e_Y:P(Y) ≃ Gamma(Y_et,Y.hom^*F) is given. Assume it carries restriction along each X-map g:Z→Y to the inverse-image unit at the terminal object over Y followed by the inverse terminal transport for the triangle Z→Y→X. Then P is a sheaf for the small pro-etale topology. This is a statement about a single presheaf and contains neither a coefficient functor nor an identification with the comparison inverse image.
Conventions: small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]; inverse images, their units and composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]; terminal section transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport].

proof.text: Check the sheaf condition on generating pro-etale covering presieves, written as arrow families. Their underlying scheme families are fpqc.

Normalize any matching family using the terminal composition isomorphisms. Its fpqc compatibility is exactly the matching-transport statement. Apply the existing unique fpqc descent theorem to Y.hom^*F.

The terminal lift is inverse to the second projection and hence restriction along it is injective. Combine this with the injectivity of terminal transport to identify the descended section with a P amalgamation. Fpqc uniqueness and e_Y injectivity prove uniqueness. This also covers the empty family.

theorem proEtaleComparisonSectionDescent
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (P : X.ProEtᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1))
    (e : ∀ Y : X.ProEt, P.obj (op Y) ≃
      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F).obj.obj
        (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))))
    (hres : ∀ (Y Z : X.ProEt) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (s : P.obj (op Y)),
      e Z (P.map g.op s) =
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
          (Y.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (Z.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
            ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
              (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) ≫
          (etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom g.left Z.hom g.w F).inv) (e Y s)) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) P
